args.subject: I made a spicy tuna roll at the sushi workshop
args.body:
Hi Jack,

I wanted to share that at the sushi-making workshop I attended with my friend Alex at the Japanese Cultural Center, I was particularly proud of the spicy tuna roll I made.

Thought you'd enjoy hearing that!

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: The Rustic Kitchen on Oak Street
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I tried The Rustic Kitchen on Oak Street last night with my colleague Lisa. The ambiance was cozy, and we absolutely loved their signature truffle risotto. I highly recommend it for a delightful dining experience.

If you decide to go, I’d be happy to join or share more details.

Best regards,

args.subject: Weekend trip to the countryside with Sarah
args.body:
Hi Alice,

Just wanted to share what Sarah and I did during our weekend trip to the countryside. We explored charming little towns, went hiking in the lush forests, and had a relaxing time away from the city.

Best regards,

args.subject: Stargazing on my weekend mountain trip
args.body:
Hi Grace,

When Emily and I went to the mountains for the weekend, we spent the nights stargazing. The sky was clear and we enjoyed a peaceful, star-filled evening by the lake — it was one of the highlights of the trip.

Thought you’d like to know!

Best,

args.subject: My new favorite wine — Merlot
args.body:
Hi Jack,

I wanted to share that I discovered a new favorite wine at the vineyard wine tasting last Saturday — a Merlot that I absolutely loved. Thought you might like to know!

Best,
